text:
dena: FYI ran the int8 compact run for model-multembed and seeing large recall drop specifically for Spanish/French queries vs float16. Not sure if it's a quant scale problem or a calibration mismatch.
ryan: Drop numbers? small validation vs float16 baseline?
dena: Quick snapshot from 10k holdout (same seeds):
``nmodel: model-multembed-int8
langs: en/es/fr
recall@1: en 0.84 | es 0.59 | fr 0.60
recall@10: en 0.96 | es 0.82 | fr 0.81
baseline float16 recall@1: en 0.85 | es 0.82 | fr 0.81
mean_cosine_shift (post - pre): en -0.01 | es -0.20 | fr -0.18
```
sophia: Those cosine shifts are alarming. Did you use global scale or per-channel?
dena: We used symmetric per-tensor with static calibrator (default pipeline). Also ran int6 toy and saw smaller but similar language gap.
liam: Could be final projection quantization — small errors there cause big angle changes. Can you check L2 norm distribution pre/post quant by lang?
dena: Ran that: pre-fp16 L2 means [en 1.05, es 1.00, fr 1.01], post-int8 [en 1.03, es 0.70, fr 0.72]. So non-en lost magnitude.
ryan: That points to scale mismatch in the projection or an activation clamp during quant. Any fused ops or custom kernels in int8 path that differ?
sophia: Also try mean-centering (subtract per-batch mean) as quick diagnostic. If similarity recovers then magnitude shift is the culprit.
dena: Did centering on sample batch: es recall@1 improved to 0.77 and fr to 0.76 (int8). So magnitude mostly explains it.
liam: Good detective work. For fixes: 1) try per-channel quant (weights) + 2) keep final linear/proj in fp16 (mixed-precision) + 3) use a calibration set balanced by language.
dena: Spun an ablation job with that combo: job id embed/1741113333/ablationA. Expect ~45min.
quant-bot: Job embed/1741113333/ablationA finished. Results summary: per-channel + fp16-proj + lang-balanced-calib reduces recall gap by ~88%. recall@1 now en 0.84 es 0.81 fr 0.80 on the sample set.
ryan: Great. Add a targeted unit test to onboarding: stratified recall thresholds per-language and a cosine-distribution check. Gate quant merges on that.
sophia: Also update the quant guide: note that multilingual compacting requires per-channel or mixed final proj. Add a short how-to for calibration sampling.
dena: Will add tests + doc blurb. Filing ticket ML-541 for rollout + regression. Plan: patch quant-config -> run full 100k holdout -> canary deploy. Assignments: dena (config + tests), liam (calibration tooling), ryan (canary infra), sophia (model card writeup).
liam: I'll update the calib script to support stratified sample sizes by lang.
ryan: Keep an eye on throughput bump if we do fp16 final proj. If perf hit >4% we need to consider hybrid quant schedule.
dena: Noted. Running full holdout now: run id embed/1741113333/full-holdout. ETA ~2h. Will post results here.
sophia: Thanks — please include cluster purity and a UMAP before/after in the holdout artifact.
dena: Yep attaching artifacts when done. :spiral_notepad:
